There is a point P on the left arc, and a point Q on the upper-right arc. The figure draws radius-related line segments such as OP, OQ, OR, OL, as well as chords PQ, QR and line segment LQ. At the left point P, 32° is marked, which is ∠OPQ; at the right endpoint R, 67° is marked, which is ∠ORQ; α represents the angle formed by QP and QL at point Q, and in the figure the label is slightly moved away for clarity. Reasoning: Because O is the center of the circle, OP, OQ, OR, OL are all radii. First look at triangle OQR, OQ = OR, therefore it is an isosceles triangle. Given ∠ORQ = 67°, so ∠OQR = 67°. Thus the central angle ∠QOR = 180° - 67° - 67° = 46°. Since L, O, R are on the same diameter, ∠LOR = 180°, so ∠LOQ = 180° - 46° = 134°. Then look at triangle LOQ, LO = OQ, also an isosceles triangle, therefore ∠LQO = (180° - 134°) / 2 = 23°. Also in triangle OPQ, OP = OQ, and it is given that ∠OPQ = 32°, so ∠OQP = 32°. At point Q, ray QL lies between QP and QO, so α = ∠PQO - ∠LQO = 32° - 23° = 9°.

raw_record.question_text: The figure shows a semicircle with center $O$. Two of the angles are given. What is the size, in degrees, of the angle $\alpha$?

method.method_draft: Label the left endpoint of the diameter as L, the right endpoint as R, the left point on the arc with the 32° mark as P, and the upper-right point on the arc as Q. From the image, alpha is the angle at Q between QP and QL, drawn slightly away from Q for readability. Since O is the center, OP, OQ, OR, and OL are radii. In triangle OQR, OR = OQ and the given 67° angle at R is also ∠ORQ, so ∠OQR = 67° and ∠QOR = 46°. Therefore ∠LOQ = 180° - 46° = 134°. In isosceles triangle LOQ, ∠LQO = (180° - 134°)/2 = 23°. In isosceles triangle OPQ, OP = OQ, and the given ∠OPQ = 32°, so ∠OQP = 32°. At Q, ray QL lies between QP and QO, so alpha = ∠PQL = ∠P Q O - ∠L Q O = 32° - 23° = 9°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个以 O 为圆心的半圆，水平直径的左端记为 L，右端记为 R。左侧圆弧上有点 P，右上圆弧上有点 Q。图中画出了 OP、OQ、OR、OL 等半径相关线段，以及弦 PQ、QR 和线段 LQ。左侧点 P 处标有 32°，这是 ∠OPQ；右端点 R 处标有 67°，这是 ∠ORQ；α 表示点 Q 处由 QP 和 QL 形成的角，图中为了清楚略微移开标注。

推理：因为 O 是圆心，所以 OP、OQ、OR、OL 都是半径。先看三角形 OQR，OQ = OR，因此它是等腰三角形。已知 ∠ORQ = 67°，所以 ∠OQR = 67°。于是中心角 ∠QOR = 180° - 67° - 67° = 46°。由于 L、O、R 在同一直径上，∠LOR = 180°，所以 ∠LOQ = 180° - 46° = 134°。再看三角形 LOQ，LO = OQ，也是等腰三角形，因此 ∠LQO = (180° - 134°) / 2 = 23°。又在三角形 OPQ 中，OP = OQ，且已知 ∠OPQ = 32°，所以 ∠OQP = 32°。在点 Q 处，射线 QL 位于 QP 与 QO 之间，所以 α = ∠PQO - ∠LQO = 32° - 23° = 9°。

The given 67° at R is the inscribed angle ∠LRQ, so it subtends minor arc LQ, giving arc LQ = 2 × 67° = 134°. The given 32° is ∠OPQ.
